name: Parallel Bar Dip
description: Lower and raise the body between fixed parallel bars using the chest and arms.

items.content: Grip stable bars beside the hips and support the body with straight arms.
Keep shoulders away from the ears, brace the trunk, and lean slightly forward.
Bend the elbows back while keeping forearms close to vertical.
Lower only through a comfortable shoulder range; do not bounce or let shoulders roll forward.
Press back to straight arms without swinging; use foot assistance if needed.

stages.name: Support
stages.description: Body supported above two fixed parallel bars with straight arms, hands beside hips, shoulders lowered and feet clear of the floor.

stages.name: Lowered
stages.description: Body lowered between parallel bars with elbows bent, upper arms approximately horizontal and forearms near vertical. Torso leans slightly forward, knees are bent and feet remain clear of the floor.
